active_systems.name: Cyclonic Storm 'MITHILA'
active_systems.basin: North Indian Ocean - Bay of Bengal

sea_state.fishermen_warning: Do not venture into the sea off the Odisha and north Andhra Pradesh coasts until 02 September 23:30 IST.

IN-MH-MUM.fishermen_warning: Squally weather with wind speed 45-55 km/h likely along and off the Maharashtra coast. Fishermen advised not to venture out.

IN-TN-CHN.fishermen_warning: No warning. Sea conditions favourable for small-craft operation up to 12 nautical miles.

IN-KL-KCH.fishermen_warning: Kallakkadal (swell surge) advisory: waves of 2.0-2.5 m likely along the Kerala coast. Avoid beach recreation.

IN-GJ-PBD.fishermen_warning: Strong winds of 40-50 km/h gusting to 60 km/h over the Gujarat coast and adjoining Arabian Sea.

IN-OD-PRI.fishermen_warning: CYCLONE MITHILA: Total suspension of fishing operations. Return all boats to harbour immediately.

IN-OD-BBS.fishermen_warning: CYCLONE MITHILA: Fishing operations suspended. Boats must remain in harbour.

IN-AP-VSK.fishermen_warning: Squally winds of 55-65 km/h likely off the north Andhra coast. Fishermen advised to remain ashore.

IN-WB-KOL.fishermen_warning: Rough seas over the north Bay of Bengal. Fishing operations suspended in Sundarbans estuarine zones.

IN-GA-PAN.fishermen_warning: High-wave alert for 2.0-2.5 m waves. Avoid venturing into the sea in small craft.
